Definition: from G1909 and G2250; for a day ("ephemeral"), i.e. diurnal:--daily.
BiblicalUsage: Ephemeros means daily, for a day — and James uses it of the brother or sister who is naked and destitute of daily food. The word makes the need urgent: not a plan for next month, but bread for today.
TheologicalSignificance: Daily needs test whether our faith is real, I hold: a blessing without bread is no blessing at all.
